executivePulse.interpretation: Conditions in memory and AI infrastructure remain strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-26 reviewed eight relevant reports; there is no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields may relieve pressure but will reach the market with delay. For buyers, securing supply, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain critical.
